remarks: Nestled in the Sylvan Knoll Community, this charming 2-bed, 1-bath, 3-level townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern updates. Sylvan Knoll is a quiet, pet-friendly, owner-occupied co-op complex where taxes are included in the monthly common charges. Step inside to find newly refinished hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, and double-pane windows with new blinds and trims. The opened wall allows natural light to pass through living and dining areas and the kitchen is outfitted with a Frigidaire refrigerator, 4-burner gas stove with a vented hood, and ample cabinet space. Upstairs features hardwood floors that have been sanded and stained, with fresh trim throughout. Complete bathroom remodel with new fixtures, waterproofing, tiling, flooring, and finishing touches. Additional highlights include a 2023 water heater, Nest thermostat system for efficient heating and cooling, and an attic with flooring and insulation-providing excellent storage. The lower level is complete with well-maintained tile flooring and a separate storage/utility room with a new LG washer and electric dryer. Outside enjoy a private patio and garden, with easy access to parking. Conveniently located near Exit 9 on I-95, and just minutes from Cove Island Beach, Cummings Park, Chelsea Piers Athletic Club, plus a short drive to downtown Stamford and the Metro-North station. This home has been thoughtfully maintained and updated, making it truly move-in ready!
